To add user authentication to your Rails app, we'll use **Devise**, a popular authentication solution. Below is the complete setup: ```ruby # Gemfile gem 'devise' ``` ```bash # Run bundle install and generate Devise models bundle install rails generate devise:install rails generate devise User rails db:migrate ``` ```ruby # config/routes.rb Rails.application.routes.draw do devise_for :users root to: "home#index" end ``` ```ruby # app/models/user.rb class User < ApplicationRecord devise :database_authenticatable, :registerable, :recoverable, :rememberable, :validatable end ``` ```erb <% if user_signed_in? %>

Hello, <%= current_user.email %>!

<%= link_to 'Sign Out', destroy_user_session_path, method: :delete %> <% else %> <%= link_to 'Sign In', new_user_session_path %> <%= link_to 'Sign Up', new_user_registration_path %> <% end %> ``` This sets up user authentication with sign-in, sign-up, password recovery, and session management.
